svg.title: Chain added in place: each add goes straight into the chain
svg.desc: Three add commands, each ending in chain:1, put omx-comp, omx-delay and omx-drive straight into the chain's worker. No plugin gets a worker of its own on the way. The result is the same single worker holding a chain of three.
